title: [ci/cd][nightly] windows xpu - cannot find zipfile directory in libtorch.zip
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

see nightly binaries run [here](https://github.com/pytorch/test-infra/actions/runs/17327975107)

```
++ curl https://download.pytorch.org/libtorch/nightly/cu130/libtorch-win-shared-with-deps-latest.zip -o libtorch.zip
  % Total    % Received % Xferd  Average Speed   Time    Time     Time  Current
                                 Dload  Upload   Total   Spent    Left  Speed

  0     0    0     0    0     0      0      0 --:--:-- --:--:-- --:--:--     0
100   275    0   275    0     0   2487      0 --:--:-- --:--:-- --:--:--  2522
++ unzip libtorch.zip
  End-of-central-directory signature not found.  Either this file is not
  a zipfile, or it constitutes one disk of a multi-part archive.  In the
  latter case the central directory and zipfile comment will be found on
  the last disk(s) of this archive.
Archive:  libtorch.zip
unzip:  cannot find zipfile directory in one of libtorch.zip or
        libtorch.zip.zip, and cannot find libtorch.zip.ZIP, period.
Error: Process completed with exit code 9.
```

cc:  @EikanWang  @atalman @Camyll 

### Versions

wheel-py3_11, py3_12, py3_13

cc @gujinghui @EikanWang @fengyuan14 @guangyey
